notes: Human Foods Program letter combining unapproved-new-drug and misbranding charges (disease-treatment claims on labels/website for Diabetic Advantage, Yacon Root Extract, Nattokinase Max, Viral Immune Booster, Arthritis Bursitis Rheumatism, and Respiratory Response) with five dietary-supplement CGMP violations under 21 CFR Part 111 (missing product/component specifications, incomplete master manufacturing and batch production records, inadequate lab controls) that adulterate Diabetic Advantage and Respiratory Response under 402(g)(1). Classified as food_supplement since the CGMP/Part 111 adulteration section is the most substantial charge, though unapproved_new_drug and misbranding are also cited. issuing_office uses the published office name 'Human Foods Program' (not one of the listed acronyms).
